FM05.reasoning: The dataset contains a 'date' column representing the time of sale, but the agent uses a random shuffle split instead of a time-based split, which can introduce look-ahead bias.

other_failure_modes.name: Target transformation mismatch with evaluation metric
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies a log transformation to the target variable and trains all models to optimize MSE on this log scale. While this stabilizes variance, it effectively optimizes for RMSLE rather than the specified task metric of RMSE, leading to systematic underprediction of high-value targets and worse final performance on the actual metric.

summary: The agent implements a highly structured pipeline with excellent feature engineering, proper cross-validation isolation for scaling/imputing, and an optimized ensemble. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random K-Fold split, and it incorrectly optimizes for RMSLE (via a log transformation of the target) instead of the required RMSE metric.
